title: When a Git TUI must catch up: bounded filesystem events
titleZh: Git TUI 如何追赶文件变化：有界文件系统事件队列
summary: How Forge handles bursts of filesystem notifications, explicit queue overflow, Git worktree metadata, and authoritative state refresh. Includes source references and a focused test command.
summaryZh: 从实际源码出发，介绍 Forge 如何处理突发文件变更、有界事件队列溢出、Git worktree 元数据及状态刷新，并提供源码引用与测试复现命令。
